(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix TCO-Policies-List. For more information - https://coralogix.com/docs/tco-optimizer-api.
id  tftypes.String computed
    description: The fixed id of this singleton: there is one per company.
policies  nested LIST computed
policies.actions  nested SINGLE computed
    description: The actions to apply the policy on. Applies the policy on all the actions by default.
policies.actions.names  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
policies.actions.rule_type  tftypes.String computed
policies.applications  nested SINGLE computed
    description: The applications to apply the policy on. Applies the policy on all the applications by default.
policies.applications.names  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
policies.applications.rule_type  tftypes.String computed
policies.archive_retention_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Allowing logs with a specific retention to be tagged.
policies.description  tftypes.String computed
    description: The policy description
policies.dpxl_expression  tftypes.String computed
    description: DataPrime expression to match spans for this policy. Mutually exclusive with the structured matchers (`services`, `actions`, `tags`, `applications`, `subsystems`) — set either this or those. Omit the attribute to clear it; an empty string is rejected by the API. The expression must include a version prefix, e.g. `<v1> $d.status == 'ERROR'`.
policies.enabled  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Determines weather the policy will be enabled. True by default.
policies.id  tftypes.String computed
    description: tco-policy ID.
policies.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: tco-policy name.
policies.order  tftypes.Number computed
    description: The policy's order between the other policies.
policies.priority  tftypes.String computed
    description: The policy priority. Can be one of ["block" "high" "low" "medium"]. When `quota_based_priority_override` is set, this is also the fallback priority applied once all `usage_tiers` are exhausted — the equivalent of "Route the remaining quota to" in the UI — and must be more restrictive than the last tier's priority (most to least restrictive: `block`, `low`, `medium`, `high`).
policies.quota_based_priority_override  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Dynamically reassign the policy's priority based on daily quota consumption tiers. Once all `usage_tiers` are exhausted, the policy's top-level `priority` is used as the fallback ("Route the remaining quota to" in the UI), which must be more restrictive than the last tier. Omit the attribute to clear it.
policies.quota_based_priority_override.usage_tiers  nested LIST computed
    description: Ordered list of quota-consumption tiers; the priority is dynamically reassigned to the matching tier's `priority` once `daily_quota_percentage` is reached. The API requires `daily_quota_percentage` to strictly increase and `priority` to strictly decrease across the list, with every tier's priority strictly above the policy's base `priority`; violations are rejected at apply time.
policies.quota_based_priority_override.usage_tiers.daily_quota_percentage  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Daily quota consumption (in percent) at which this tier becomes active. Must be between 0 and 100.
policies.quota_based_priority_override.usage_tiers.priority  tftypes.String computed
    description: The priority to apply when this tier is active. Can be one of ["high" "low" "medium"] (`block` is not valid for a tier).
policies.services  nested SINGLE computed
    description: The services to apply the policy on. Applies the policy on all the services by default.
policies.services.names  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
policies.services.rule_type  tftypes.String computed
policies.subsystems  nested SINGLE computed
    description: The subsystems to apply the policy on. Applies the policy on all the subsystems by default.
policies.subsystems.names  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
policies.subsystems.rule_type  tftypes.String computed
policies.tags  nested MAP computed
    description: The tags to apply the policy on. Applies the policy on all the tags by default.
policies.tags.names  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
policies.tags.rule_type  tftypes.String computed
